# LIVELY HOTELS

> > LIVELY HOTELS operates a portfolio of lifestyle hotel brands across Japan, including THE LIVELY, ESTINATE, UNWIND, Hi! GRAPHY, THE MILLENNIALS, slash, and CASPER, offering unique urban accommodation experiences.

LIVELY HOTELS is a Japanese hospitality group specializing in lifestyle and boutique hotels in major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka. The company combines modern design, community-focused experiences, and digital innovation to create distinctive stays that connect travelers with local culture.
